title: div_ceil helper duplicated in 5 modules
description:
The same div_ceil function appears identically in 5 places:
- compress.rs:91-93
- wire.rs:15-17
- no_ack.rs:15-17
- ack_on_error.rs:27-29
- ack_always.rs:18-20

What goes wrong: Maintenance burden - any fix or optimization must be applied in 5 places. Risk of divergence.

Rewrite: Add to lib.rs or a utils module:
```rust
/// Integer division rounding up (compatible with MSRV 1.70).
#[inline]
pub(crate) const fn div_ceil(a: usize, b: usize) -> usize {
    (a + b - 1) / b
}
```

Then `use crate::div_ceil;` in each module.

Files: /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/lib.rs (target), compress.rs, wire.rs, no_ack.rs, ack_on_error.rs, ack_always.rs (sources)
